title: A locally dominated n-vector density pulled back along a measurable map defines a current
statement: Let P, Q, n ∈ ℕ. Let V ⊆ ℝ^Q be any set and μ any measure on ℝ^P. Let g : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q be μ-a.e. measurable. Let w : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^Q) be μ-a.e. strongly measurable; here Λ_n(ℝ^Q) = NVector (Eucl Q) n is the space of continuous linear functionals on n-covectors of ℝ^Q, with the operator norm. Assume that for every compact K ⊆ V there is a μ-integrable h : ℝ^P → ℝ with ‖w(x)‖ ≤ h(x) for μ-a.e. x satisfying g(x) ∈ K. Then there is S ∈ D_n(V) (a GeometricCurrentOn V n) such that S(ω) = ∫ w(x)(ω(g(x))) dμ(x) for every test form ω ∈ Dⁿ(V) (TestFormOn V n).
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (V : Set (Eucl Q)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (g : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (w : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl Q) n), AEMeasurable g μ → AEStronglyMeasurable w μ → (∀ K : Set (Eucl Q), IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → ∃ h : Eucl P → ℝ, Integrable h μ ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, g x ∈ K → ‖w x‖ ≤ h x) → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn V n, ∀ ω : TestFormOn V n, S ω = ∫ x, w x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl Q) n) (g x)) ∂μ
